title: Continuity — motion design, as code
logline: For skeptical designers: AI agents can now make motion you'd ship, because they can finally see their own work.

scenes.intent: Stake the claim: motion design is a craft (earn trust with designers).

beats.note: 'a craft.' is placed — the scene's one expressive moment
'Motion is' steps to the grey; 'a craft.' leads

elements.note: the setup line; recedes to the grey at b3

scenes.motion: Lit from above (the hero). Two display lines, left-aligned on the piece's one top edge. l1 masks up by line on the responsive spring; l2 masks up on the expressive spring. Once both have landed l1 dims to the grey at the instant tier, so rank comes from ink. A 3% camera push carries the hold. Hard cut out.

scenes.intent: The turn: agents can already write motion code.

beats.note: 'write it.' types on; 'Agents can' steps back

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. l1 masks up by line (responsive). At b2 l1 dims and l2 types on at a human rate — writing, literally; that is the scene's moment, so no expressive spring. When the last character lands, the caret appears at the instant tier and blinks (the one loop litt allows). Hard cut out.

scenes.intent: Tension: they can't see what they make.

beats.note: 'see' steps to the grey — the word they can't do

elements.note: the word inside l3 that dims

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. Three lines mask up 80ms apart, l1 and l2 responsive, l3 expressive (the scene's moment). At b2 the word 'see' — and only it — dims to the grey: the inverse of the piece's ink rule, the problem made visible. Hard cut out (the turn lives on the cut).

scenes.intent: Resolution: we gave them eyes — the contact sheet as proof.

beats.note: the contact sheet cascades in; 'So we gave' steps back
the agent's focus ring lands on the first frame, then reads along the row

elements.note: t1–t8: frames of this very video, a 4×2 contact sheet (imagery, read from the storyboard copy)
litt's focus ring: what the agent is looking at

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. l1 responsive, l2 expressive (the moment). At b2 the eight frames rise 32px on the responsive spring, 40ms apart, and l1 dims. At b3 the focus ring appears at the instant tier and glides frame to frame on the responsive spring — the gliding highlight, the agent reading its own sheet. 3% camera push. Hard cut out.

beats.note: the check draws; 'Every frame,' steps back

elements.note: a check mark in fg at the display stem weight

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. l1 responsive, l2 expressive. At b2 the check draws on beside 'checked.' (slow, inOut) while l1 dims. Dip to the canvas into the end card: the video's one accent transition.

beats.note: label, then the wordmark is placed

scenes.motion: Lit from above again; the piece's one centered statement. The label fades in, the wordmark settles (rises 32px from 0.98 on the expressive spring), the tagline rises in the grey. A 3% camera push holds it.
